clue.text: Poet regularly longs for fruit

indicators.note: regularly means take every other letter of the word Poet, starting with the first

parts.note: to long for something is to ache for it, so longs gives aches

explanation.surface: A poet who keeps pining for something sweet to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: Peaches are a soft stone fruit, so the plural noun is an example of fruit.

clue.text: Piece of cake to eat outdoors

definitions.meaning: something very easy to do, a doddle
to have a meal in the open air on a rug or bench

explanation.surface: A slice of cake eaten out in the garden.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun is slang for an easy task; the verb means to dine out of doors.

clue.text: Sailor employed and mistreated

parts.note: AB, able seaman, is the crossword sailor
employed means put to use, used

explanation.surface: A sailor taken on and then badly treated by his employers.
explanation.definitionFit: To have been abused is to have been treated cruelly or wrongly, the same as mistreated.

clue.text: Pity he's so confused about hard theory

indicators.note: about means around, so the jumbled letters go around the hard letter
confused means muddled, so the letters of the three words are rearranged

parts.note: H is the pencil-grade abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A shame that he struggles so much with a tough theory.
explanation.definitionFit: A proposed explanation still to be tested is a theory in the loose sense.

clue.text: Mark put on female item of clothing

indicators.note: put on places the mark on top of the female letter in a down entry

parts.note: a scar is a mark left on the skin

explanation.surface: A stain spotted on a woman's garment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put on' suggests dressing, but in a down answer it sets SCAR above F.
explanation.definitionFit: A length of cloth worn around the neck is an example of an item of clothing.

clue.text: Model, after work, departs hostile

indicators.note: after places the model's word behind the word for work

parts.note: OP is the usual short form of opus, a musical work
to model for an artist is to pose
D is the timetable abbreviation for departs

explanation.surface: A model sitting for an artist after a job, then leaving in a foul mood.
explanation.definitionFit: Being set against something is being hostile to it, a close synonym in the sense of opposition.

clue.text: Ignoring golf, Roger's chat disturbed group of players

indicators.note: disturbed means thrown into disorder, so the remaining letters are rearranged
ignoring says the golf letter is left out of the pool of letters

parts.note: G is golf in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Skipping the golf talk, Roger's chatter annoyed his playing partners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbed' rearranges ROGERS CHAT once G (golf) is dropped, signalled by 'Ignoring'.
explanation.definitionFit: A large ensemble of musicians performing together is a group of players.

clue.text: Opening mail

definitions.meaning: a job vacancy, an opening in a firm

explanation.surface: Someone opening the morning's letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a job vacancy and the letters delivered daily.

clue.text: Finally encourages parent to inhale oxygen to become calmer

indicators.note: finally says take the last letter of the word encourages
to inhale is to draw in, so the parent word takes the oxygen letter inside

parts.note: a mother is a parent
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: A parent urging a child to breathe in deeply and settle down.
explanation.definitionFit: Smoother means less rough or turbulent, so more even and calmer.

clue.text: Torment, as I had picked up accent

indicators.note: picked up means lifted, which in a down entry turns the letters upwards so they read backwards

parts.note: I had is contracted to I'd
an accent on a syllable is a stress

explanation.surface: Agony at having caught a strange way of speaking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'picked up' reads as acquiring an accent; in a down answer it turns ID upwards to DI.
explanation.definitionFit: Severe anguish or suffering is torment, used here as a noun.

clue.text: Piano to the right of china mug

indicators.note: to the right of puts the piano letter after the friend in an across entry

parts.note: china means mate in Cockney rhyming slang (china plate), so a friend or chum
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning softly

explanation.surface: A piano standing beside a china mug on a shelf.
explanation.walkthrough: 'china' and 'mug' both look like crockery; china is rhyming slang for a friend and mug means a gullible fool.
explanation.definitionFit: A mug in British slang is a gullible fool, and a chump is the same sort of dupe.

clue.text: Ten across flustered old family members

indicators.note: flustered means agitated and muddled, so the letters of the two words are jumbled

explanation.surface: Elderly relatives in a fluster over a crossword clue numbered ten across.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue is 10-across itself, so 'Ten across' reads like a cross-reference but is the anagram fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Forebears from whom a family descends are its earlier, old family members.

clue.text: International study bound to enthral if discovered

parts.note: a den is a small private room for study

indicators.note: to enthral is to hold captive, so the tied word holds the letters of if within it

parts.note: bound means tied up

explanation.surface: A global study certain to captivate anyone who chances upon it.
explanation.definitionFit: To have identified something is to have found out what it is, so discovered fits as a synonym.

clue.text: Brilliant beginning but no ending

indicators.note: no ending says the final letter of the word for beginning is dropped

parts.note: a beginning is a start

explanation.surface: A dazzling opening that never reaches its conclusion.
explanation.definitionFit: Used as an adjective, a star performance is outstanding, so brilliant is a fair synonym.

clue.text: Beating for each swear word at home entertains Oscar

parts.note: per means for each, as in miles per hour
a cuss is a curse or swear word

indicators.note: entertains means takes in as a guest, so the home word holds the Oscar letter

parts.note: in means at home
O is Oscar in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A beating for each curse uttered at home in front of a guest named Oscar.
explanation.definitionFit: Percussion is the striking or beating of one thing against another, as of drums.

clue.text: New vessel there at sea, in spite of everything

indicators.note: at sea means confused and all over the place, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A newly launched ship out on the water, whatever the odds.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb means however or all the same, which is the sense of the phrase about everything regardless.

clue.text: Life is tense after former lover starts to eat numerous chocolate eclairs

indicators.note: after places the following pieces behind the former lover

parts.note: an ex is a former partner
T is the grammar abbreviation for tense

indicators.note: starts to says take the first letter of each of the four following words

explanation.surface: Life is fraught once an ex begins eating piles of chocolate eclairs.
explanation.definitionFit: Existence is the state of being alive, which is life in its broad sense.

clue.text: Is Parisian friend after independent quotation?

indicators.note: after places the friend word behind the independent letter

parts.note: est is French for is, as a Parisian would say it
a mate is a friend

explanation.surface: A question about whether a Parisian friend follows an independent quote.
explanation.walkthrough: 'quotation' means a price quoted for a job, not a line quoted from a writer.
explanation.definitionFit: A builder's quotation is a stated price for work, which is an estimate.

clue.text: I got nan excited about Romeo in the dark

indicators.note: about means around, so the mixed letters surround the Romeo letter
excited means stirred up, so the letters of the two words are mixed up

parts.note: R is Romeo in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone thrills Grandma with a Romeo story she knew nothing of.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in the dark is an idiom for knowing nothing about a matter, which is being uninformed.

clue.text: Worried if aching, since husband's lost weight

indicators.note: worried means agitated, so the remaining letters are shaken into a new order
lost says the husband letter goes missing from the pool of letters

explanation.surface: Anxious about pains, now that a husband has slimmed down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Worried' shuffles IF ACHING SINCE once the H, for husband ('lost'), has been taken away.
explanation.definitionFit: Weight in the sense of importance or influence is the same as significance.

clue.text: Sea dog to talk foolishly about current

indicators.note: about means around, so the talking word goes around the current letter

parts.note: to prate is to chatter foolishly
I is the physics symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: An old sailor babbling nonsense about the ocean currents.
explanation.definitionFit: A sea dog is an old sailor, and a buccaneer is a sea-going robber of that kind.

clue.text: Approval going up, by the sound of it

indicators.note: by the sound of it says the word for a climb is said aloud and spelt another way

parts.note: going up is a climb, an ascent

explanation.surface: Approval ratings rising, or so it seems.
explanation.definitionFit: Assent is agreement or consent, the same as approval of a proposal.

clue.text: Some sent back application, originally, for club

indicators.note: sent back says the hidden letters are read backwards
Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An application form posted back to a golf club or some other society.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for club' looks like a membership request; it is the golf club meaning.
explanation.definitionFit: In golf an iron is a type of club used for most fairway shots, the clue's 'club'.

clue.text: Signs of nerves after government almost is revealing data

indicators.note: after places the nerve signs behind the other pieces
almost says the last letter of the word for government is cut off

parts.note: the state is the government of a country
tics are involuntary twitches, signs of nervousness

explanation.surface: A nervous twitch while a government is nearly forced to reveal figures.
explanation.definitionFit: Collected numerical facts are known as figures or data, the plural noun matching the plural definition.

clue.text: Like the main movement?

parts.note: the main is an old poetic word for the open sea, and its regular rise and fall is the tide

explanation.surface: A question about the chief motion in a piece of music or a campaign.
explanation.walkthrough: 'main' looks like principal; it is the ocean, so its movement is the tide.
explanation.definitionFit: Tidal describes the rise and fall of the sea, the main's motion.

clue.text: Python slid lengthways, to an extent

indicators.note: to an extent says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A python snake slithered along its full length for a while.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Python' looks like the snake; it is Eric Idle, a member of the Monty Python comedy team.
explanation.definitionFit: Eric of that name was one of the six Monty Python comedians, so a Python.

clue.text: Left a group working with editor

parts.note: a band is a group, especially of musicians
a machine that is on is working

explanation.surface: Someone departed with a music group, working alongside an editor.
explanation.definitionFit: Left in the sense of deserted or forsaken, as in a car left by the roadside.

clue.text: Fancy cutting out fashionable picture

indicators.note: cutting out means the word for fashionable is removed from the word for fancy

parts.note: to fancy is to imagine
in means fashionable, as in the in thing

explanation.surface: An elaborate photo with the trendy bits snipped away.
explanation.definitionFit: A visual representation or likeness of something is a picture.

clue.text: Radical half-trembles entering river

indicators.note: entering says the chosen letters go inside the river name

parts.note: the Exe is a river in Devon, south-west England

indicators.note: half says take the first half of the word trembles

explanation.surface: A political firebrand quivering as they wade into a river.
explanation.definitionFit: Radical views are those at the far edge of opinion, the same idea as extreme ones.

clue.text: Kindly left European in revolutionary hospital department

indicators.note: revolutionary means turned around, so the word in is read backwards

parts.note: ENT is the ear, nose and throat department of a hospital

explanation.surface: A kind-hearted European left working in a hospital ward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' looks like a political adjective for the department, but it is the turnaround signal acting on the short word before it.
explanation.definitionFit: Lenient means gentle and merciful in judging others, which is kindly in temperament.
